note: Commits where the archive changed because the ARCHIVER changed, not because a publisher edited anything. These diffs are ours and are labelled as such on the site so they can never be mistaken for a company altering its own document. Detected by a commit touching both scripts/archive.mjs and archive/ — recorded here permanently rather than corrected by rewriting history, because an archive that edits its own past is not an archive.

commits.ade3cd1c9ed6c239907924054af368e39eb4069f: Extraction rewritten to collapse whitespace deterministically, after the same page served twice produced a 108-line diff of identical prose.
commits.b628bd2cad4f8a1d8453d7c6569cc6d5ee4e0a26: Captured from GitHub Actions under the older, non-deterministic extractor; the apparent change is line-breaking, not content.
commits.f6ea79346ba684967eb89639f6ccff6895ed8112: First capture — the documents entering the archive, not a change to them.
commits.21d6a9b75763eb52e5706d1da6b8c447b49cb47e: Archiving switched from whole pages to the document body. The lines that vanished are navigation menus, sidebars and a cookie banner that were never part of the policy — our extraction changed, the publisher's document did not.
commits.a83189daae8f166d7be8c97407b24a70d2cf4656: Our capture stopped at a marker that does not appear on the page, so the site footer had been inside it. The 93 lines removed here are that footer. Anthropic did not change its usage policy.

Mistral redesigned its Legal Center in late August and our capture had no document boundaries at all. This diff is mostly us finally setting them. Note the effective date left the page in the redesign — that part is theirs, not ours.

caveats.a83189daae8f166d7be8c97407b24a70d2cf4656: Most lines here only lost a leading icon glyph our extractor now strips — that part is ours. The real change is one added row: claude-fable-5-1.
Captured after a nineteen-day gap in which the archive recorded nothing, so this shows the net movement over that period rather than a single day's edit.
